evidence_items.explanation: The announcement reports improved capability from tool use and, elsewhere on the page, improved o3 mathematics performance with Python. This supports the practical-benefit component under Marcus's definition, while also showing that OpenAI publicly discussed those benefits.

evidence_items.locator: Code interpreter discussion, paragraph beginning 'We provide our models'
evidence_items.explanation: OpenAI publicly disclosed model integration with symbolic code execution in 2023. This challenges a reading that OpenAI concealed the integration, but does not establish acknowledgement of its significance for neurosymbolic AI.

unresolved_gaps: The searches did not establish a comprehensive record of OpenAI statements sufficient to verify 'without any public acknowledgement whatsoever'.
The retrieved statements acknowledge tool integration and benefits, but do not clearly recognize them as support for neurosymbolic AI.
Public performance reports do not establish whether OpenAI regarded the broader intellectual implication as unintended.
